buggy.origin: simulation centre 0.23 m above level ground
buggy.wheel_pivots: FL/FR local (±0.29, -0.08, -0.25) in glTF; RL/RR z=+0.25
buggy.motion: Steer_* rotate local Y; Wheel_* rotate local X. Never animate the root scale.

hangar.clear_corridor: local x from -2.5 to +2.5, whole 22 m depth; preserve 2.6 m half-door width

materials: glTF metallic-roughness PBR; authored solids/vertex colours initially, no baked lighting; opaque except explicitly reviewed canopy
collision: named COLLISION_* proxy meshes; hidden in render, read as geometry bounds; never infer chassis collision from cosmetic antennas
lod: LOD0 first. Do not make extra LODs until measured triangle/fragment cost warrants them. Preserve pivots at every LOD.
provenance: original authored script meshes and materials under repository MIT; concept image is reference only, no proprietary source geometry or textures
validation: mesh counts and bounds from actual GLB accessors, required node names, no missing external buffers/textures, uniform unit roots, opaque collision markers

art_direction.scope: visual direction only; no approval of current gameplay assets

dino.origin: between the feet on level ground; faces -Z; clips play in place (docs/rc-characters.md)
